paragraphs.text: Nine DeepSeek Harness guard plugins in one installable set: secret-leak blocking, a per-session cost
cap, auto-formatting after edits, and more.
# dsh-guard-pack
English | 中文
Nine guard plugins for DeepSeek Harness that catch the expensive mistakes coding agents make, instal
led with one command.
Each guard watches tool calls before or after they run. When an agent is about to do something you'd
regret, the call is stopped and the model is told why and what to do instead, so it usually fixes c
ourse in the same step.
| Plugin | What it stops | npm |
| dsh-block-secret-leaks | Reading `.env` and key files, printing or uploading secrets, committing t
hem, hardcoding them in source. Redacts any that reach tool output. **New.** | [](https://www.npmjs.

com/package/dsh-block-secret-leaks) |
| dsh-session-cost-cap | A session (with its subagents) spendi
ng more than you set. Warns the model first, then asks you before each tool call. **New.** | [](http

s://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-cost-cap) |
| dsh-format-after-edit | Unformatted code. Runs P
rettier, Biome, dprint, Ruff, Black, gofmt, rustfmt or clang-format on every edited file. **New.** |

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-format-after-edit) |
| dsh-protect-tests | Edits that make tes
ts pass by testing less: `.skip`, deleted assertions, `expect(true)`. | [](https://www.npmjs.com/pac

kage/dsh-protect-tests) |
| dsh-block-placeholder-edits | `// ... existing code ...` written over re

al code. | [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-block-placeholder-edits) |
| dsh-protect-generated-f
iles | Hand edits to lockfiles and generated code. | [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-protect-ge

nerated-files) |
| dsh-enforce-package-manager | `npm install` in a pnpm repo, `pip install` in a uv

project. | [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-enforce-package-manager) |
| dsh-block-hanging-comm
ands | Commands that wait for input or never exit: editors, REPLs, dev servers, `git commit` without

`-m`. | [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-block-hanging-commands) |
| dsh-load-agent-rules | Ign
oring the Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf and Cline rule files your repo already has. | [](https://www.npm
js.com/package/dsh-load-agent-rules) |

## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The end-to-end tests include a `dsh plugin add` install, which needs `pnpm` on your PATH.
To release a package, bump its version and `CHANGELOG.md`, then push a tag named `<package>-v<versio
n>`, for example `dsh-session-cost-cap-v0.1.1`. The release workflow tests everything, publishes tha
t package to npm with trusted publishing, and creates the GitHub release.
